correctness.rationale: For α=2m, the real Hilbert–Schmidt pairing of rank-one Hermitian projectors P_u=uu* equals |<u,v>_F|^2, for F=R,C,H. Tensor power X_u=P_u^{⊗m} is injective on distinct projective lines, so exp(κ<X_u,X_v>) is the Euclidean Gaussian kernel times e^κ and is strictly positive definite on distinct finite sites. For every α>0 not even, restrict to embedded real projective line parameter t∈R/πZ, where kernel is e^{κ|cos(t-s)|^α}. Unique cusp at t=π/2 has local expansion 1+κ|t-π/2|^α+O_symbol(|t-π/2|^{α+min(α,2)}); Fourier asymptotic is (-1)^{n+1} κΓ(α+1)sin(πα/2)/(π2^α)n^{-α-1}+o(n^{-α-1}). Nonzero alternating leading sign forces infinitely many negative Fourier coefficients and rules out PSD by the compact abelian group positivity criterion. Independent finite Fourier integration found negative modes at α=1,3 and nonnegative α=2; this corroborates rather than proves all α,κ.
